_meta.source: Crystal Warden Supply Chain Labs, from the three continuous-evidence questions a real AI-compliance auditor asked (prismpath-grc/docs/AI-SAFETY-EVIDENCE.md).
_meta.provenance: An evidence-and-process control set for AI safety TESTING, assessed by the same PrismPath engine as NIST 800-171. It certifies the process (tested, retested on change, non-stale, continuously proven), NOT that the model is intrinsically safe. The model provider and the red team own model safety.
_meta.sprs: NOT SPRS-scored (SPRS is a NIST 800-171 Rev 2 construct).

AST-1.title: Retest on every model change
AST-1.control: Re-test the safety of the model after every change to the model or its configuration.

objectives.text: a safety test suite is defined.
each model version and configuration change is identified by a version hash.
a safety-test determination exists that was produced against the current model version.
no deployed model version lacks a safety-test determination bound to it.

AST-2.title: Detect stale tests
AST-2.control: Distinguish a test that passed because the model is safe from one that passed because the test itself became stale.

objectives.text: each safety test is bound to a fingerprint of the model, provider, and precision it was calibrated against.
a test whose fingerprint no longer matches the current model is refused and re-tested rather than counted as a pass.
each passing test's discrimination margin is measured against a calibrated floor.
a pass whose discrimination margin has collapsed abstains rather than being recorded as met.

AST-3.title: Continuous point-in-time proof
AST-3.control: Produce continuous, signed, replayable proof of the current safety posture, not a launch snapshot.

objectives.text: each safety-test determination is recorded as a signed receipt.
each receipt is timestamped and anchored to an independent time source.
the safety posture for a past date can be produced and its receipt verified and replayed.
safety evaluations run continuously, on a cadence and on every model change, not only at launch.

AST-4.title: Runtime input and output monitoring
AST-4.control: Monitor live inputs and outputs for drift from the safety-tested distribution and abstain or escalate.

objectives.text: live inputs and outputs are compared against the distribution the safety case was built on.
traffic that drifts beyond the calibrated bound abstains or escalates rather than proceeding.
